messages: very. i work in marketing at a startup in Gurgaon, campaigns launching every other day
watching Real Madrid match with friends tomorrow night. i am a huge madridista
Hala Madrid! Who are they playing?
Barca, clasico. i will be so tense lol
A clasico is never calm. Snacks planned?
aira are you awake? i need to say something
we had the office party tonight and i got completely drunk
Oh. Hope you got home safely. What happened?
it's so embarrassing. i threw up in my boss Mr. Tandon's car on the way back, he was dropping me
That's mortifying, but it happens more than people admit. Did he say anything?
he just said its fine and gave me water. i wanted to disappear
He sounds kind about it. Try to sleep now and sort it out tomorrow.
ya. i will apologise on monday i think
A short, sincere sorry is enough.
Goodnight Imran, drink water before bed.
aira please forget that i told you about last night. the whole car thing and the boss. dont ever bring it up
Okay Imran, I won't bring it up again.
thanks. i feel better with it gone. wanna talk about something else
going to Jaipur next weekend with my cousins
Nice. What will you do there?
forts, laal maans, and photos. my cousin has a new camera
Hawa Mahal at sunrise would look great.
will try. need to sleep again, headache
back from Jaipur. so tired but happy
Welcome back! Best part of the trip?
Amber fort at sunset and the dal baati. ate way too much
Dal baati is dangerous that way.
yes and my cousin Zaid fell asleep in the car all the way back lol
A sleepy road trip is a successful one.
hey aira. new campaign launched today, finally
also madrid won 3-1 yesterday!! what a game
Vinicius and Bellingham, mostly. good mood all day
A football win makes everything lighter.
delhi air is horrible again. AQI 380
That's terrible. Are you wearing a mask outside?
yes N95. bought an air purifier for my room
